startup_criterion: Final outputs 100us after ramp within 2% of corresponding DC point; engineering diagnostic, not a product spec.
scope: 3.0/3.3/3.6V x typical27/ss85/ff-20/sf27/fs27; real bias schematic and loaded ADC OTA clock, code2 and reset booster trim.
limits: Reference rails remain ideal fixed 1.9/1.4V and ITST load at1V; no complete reference startup or arbitrary supply ordering.
Startup uses representative mirror loads; ADC clock simulation starts from DC operating point, not integrated power-up.
Linear MOSCAP approximation, no extracted parasitics or package, no noise/mismatch/Monte Carlo.
No brownout, power cycling, all trim codes, or ADC/DAC closed-loop behavior.
Positive clock margin is a sequence screen, not minimum guardband product acceptance.
Current source netlist identity is verified; physical GDS correspondence relies on parent core LVS.

model_scope.MOSCAP_model: Linear constant-C approximation in functional/sim_work/gf180/tapeout/sim/moscap_lin.spice, not official voltage-dependent MOSCAP.
model_scope.affected_tests: All 45 bias startup cases; actual-bias 15 schematic-clock cases; nominal/cap/RC comparisons; 75 clock device/RC cases and numerical controls.
model_scope.limitation: Circuit source matching and clock extraction audit do not validate nonlinear MOSCAP behavior, full-chip startup, accuracy, or manufacturing signoff.
model_scope.formula: NMOS: factor*L*W*3.983e-3 F/m2; PMOS: factor*L*W*3.958e-3 F/m2; factor typical=1, ff=.9, ss=1.1.
